lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Thaís Aparecida | Lesson 9 -- Can Thaís Do It?
lesson.grammar_point: can / can't for ability and permission

listenings.text: Good morning, and welcome to the museum. Before you go in, please listen to three small rules. You can take photos, but you can't use a flash. Big bags can't go inside, so please leave your bag at the desk on the left. It is free. You can eat and drink in the cafe on the first floor, but you can't eat in the rooms with the paintings. If you can't find something, you can ask any person in a blue shirt. They can all speak English. And one more thing: you can come back tomorrow with the same ticket. Have a very good visit.

Hello. This is the information line for taxis and the metro in Paris. Here is what you can do. At the taxi stand you can pay with a credit card in every taxi. You can also call this number for a taxi, but you can't call after eleven o'clock at night. For the metro, you can buy a ticket at the machine or at the window. The machine can speak English, so you can change the language before you buy. Children under four can travel free. And if you can't find your station, you can ask the person at the window. She can help you with a map. Thank you, and have a very good day in Paris.

extra_audio.text: Can I buy three tickets, please? Can you speak slowly, please? Now I can understand. I can take photos, but I can't use a flash. Can we come back tomorrow?
